Hotels

Where comfort and security go hand in hand

Coloron/Solutions/Solutions by Scenario/Hotel Security Management Solution

Solution overview

The hospitality industry relies heavily on guest satisfaction and a welcoming atmosphere. Ensuring safety for guests, personnel, and property without being intrusive is key to building a memorable hotel brand.

Coloron's Hotel Security Management Solution brings together intelligent vehicle access control, indoor parking guidance, discreet lobby surveillance, queue detection at reception, keyless room entry, and perimeter protection on a unified management platform.

FACILITY 1

Hotel Parking Lot & Valet Area

High-speed ANPR camera automatically admits registered VIP guests and hotel patrons without barrier tickets. Overhead dual-lens parking guidance cameras direct arriving drivers to vacant parking stalls using vibrant green/red indicators.

Hospitality Impact: Reduces guest parking time from 10 minutes to under 60 seconds while providing complete forecourt security.
Recommended Core Hardware
Smart Parking Guidance & ANPR Terminal (DS-TPE400)
Key Performance Specs
98%+ plate accuracy, dual-bay space detection, dynamic LED space occupancy sign, anti-tailgating radar

Parking Lot

Challenges

First impressions begin at the hotel driveway. Long queues at parking barriers and frustrating searches for available parking spaces harm guest satisfaction.

Rush hour processing efficiency

During convention check-ins or wedding banquets, manual parking ticket issuance causes entrance congestion, blocking hotel driveways and delaying VIP arrivals.

Difficult finding available parking spaces

In large multi-level hotel parking garages, wandering without guidance leads to customer frustration, wasted fuel, and accidental minor vehicle scrapes.

What we offer

Enhance the arrival experience with ticketless high-accuracy ANPR barrier gates, automated indoor space guidance, and real-time vehicle locator kiosks.

Benefits

  • Ticketless guest drive-through with zero delay at hotel gates.
  • VIP recognition alerts front-desk staff before guests reach the lobby.
  • Reduces parking congestion and prevents unauthorized long-term parking.

Features

  • Up to 98%+ ANPR accuracy across multinational license plates.
  • Overhead 2-in-1 camera detects space occupancy and records high-res video.
  • LED digital guidance signs show real-time available spaces per floor.
  • Touchscreen "Find My Car" kiosks guide guests to parked vehicles.

System Topology

Hotel Parking Management & Guidance Architecture

Interconnects Entrance ANPR Terminals, Indoor Dual-Lens Guidance Cameras, Video Intercom Stations, Barrier Gates, and PMS Hotel Property Management.

iDS-TCM403-BI Smart ANPR Entrance Terminal

  • Integrates 4MP sensor, motorized zoom lens, DarkFighter illumination, and deep learning ANPR.
  • Built-in barrier control relay triggers gate release within 0.3s of license plate confirmation.
